note: Printable PDF is a submodule of Printable providing the 'pdf' PrintableFormat plugin (PdfFormat), which renders content entities as PDF via pdf_api. It depends on printable + pdf_api and has NO config object of its own; it reads the parent's printable.settings. Adds /{entity}/printable/pdf. Key settings it consumes: pdf_tool (pdf_api generator: wkhtmltopdf/tcpdf/mpdf/dompdf; empty => 404), printable_pdf_link_locations (where PDF links show), save_pdf (true=download/attachment, false=inline), paper_size, page_orientation. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the pdf-specific printable.settings keys (printable_pdf_link_locations and save_pdf), distinct from the parent module's cases. Baselines restored explicitly: printable_pdf_link_locations=[''], save_pdf=false.

evals.prompt: What does the printable_pdf submodule add on top of the printable module, and what other module does it require to actually produce a PDF?
evals.expected_output: It adds the 'pdf' PrintableFormat plugin (PdfFormat), giving each printable entity a /{entity}/printable/pdf URL. It requires the pdf_api module (and a toolkit) to generate the PDF; the toolkit is chosen in printable.settings.pdf_tool.

evals.prompt: With printable_pdf, which setting decides whether the generated PDF is downloaded as a file attachment or shown inline in the browser?
evals.expected_output: printable.settings.save_pdf: when TRUE the PDF is returned as an attachment (download), when FALSE it is shown inline. (printable_pdf reads the parent printable.settings; it has no config of its own.)

evals.prompt: In printable_pdf, which configuration key controls on which entity types the PDF link is displayed, and where is it edited?
evals.expected_output: printable.settings.printable_pdf_link_locations lists the entity types that show a PDF link. It is edited on the parent form at /admin/config/user-interface/printable/links/pdf (route printable.pdf_ui).

evals.prompt: On this site, on which entity type(s) is the printable PDF link currently configured to appear? Inspect the live configuration and answer.
evals.expected_output: Node: printable.settings.printable_pdf_link_locations is ['node'], so the PDF link shows on node entities.

evals.prompt: Right now, does the printable_pdf module serve generated PDFs as a download (attachment) or inline in the browser on this site? Inspect the live configuration to decide.
evals.expected_output: As a download (attachment): printable.settings.save_pdf is TRUE, so PdfFormat returns the PDF with a Content-Disposition of attachment rather than inline.

evals.prompt: Configure the printable_pdf module so that a PDF download link appears on node pages, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add 'node' to printable.settings.printable_pdf_link_locations (e.g. set it to ['node'] via the config API, or tick node on /admin/config/user-interface/printable/links/pdf). in_array('node', printable_pdf_link_locations) is then TRUE.

evals.prompt: Change the printable_pdf configuration so that generated PDFs are downloaded as a file (attachment) instead of being shown inline in the browser. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set printable.settings.save_pdf to TRUE (e.g. drush cset printable.settings save_pdf 1 -y, or the config API, or the PDF config form). \Drupal::config('printable.settings')->get('save_pdf') is then TRUE, so PdfFormat sends the PDF as an attachment.
